results.change_intent: Add a setting to Sudden Death mod in osu! ruleset that fails the player upon missing a slider tail.
results.summary: Implements slider tail failure handling for Sudden Death, but duplicates the base fail condition and uses misleading setting naming.

issues.evidence: [SettingSource("PFC mode", "Fail when missing on a slider tail")]
issues.comment: The label "PFC mode" is misleading. In osu! and rhythm games generally, "PFC" stands for "Perfect Full Combo" (100% accuracy / all 300s). Sudden Death only fails on combo breaks, meaning players can still get 100s or 50s without failing; enabling this option does not enforce a PFC.
issues.suggestion: Rename the setting label to accurately reflect its effect, such as "Fail on slider tail miss" or "Strict slider tails".
issues.suggested_code: [SettingSource("Fail on slider tail miss", "Fail when missing on a slider tail")]

issues.comment: The combo failure logic duplicates the implementation already present in ModSuddenDeath.FailCondition.
issues.suggestion: Delegate to base.FailCondition(healthProcessor, result) instead of duplicating the condition.
